collection.title: Six Islands, Six Stories
collection.description: Each fragrance is an olfactory journey through the soul of the Indonesian archipelago — six islands, six stories, one nation breathed into being.

items.title: Cultural Storytelling
items.description: Telling the beauty of Indonesian culture and islands through the art of fragrance and artistic perfume design.

items.title: Accessible Luxury
items.description: Presenting high-quality perfumes at accessible prices, so that more people can experience the splendor of the Nusantara.

items.title: Indonesian Aesthetic
items.description: Using designs and packaging that represent the aesthetic values and unique character of Indonesia.

items.title: Environmental Stewardship
items.description: Contributing to environmental sustainability by supporting organizations dedicated to the preservation of Indonesia's nature.

items.title: Education & Pride
items.description: Becoming an educational medium that cultivates pride and love for the beauty and richness of Indonesia's cultural heritage.
Celebrating authentic works and raw materials born from our own soil.
Caring for and preserving the nature where all these stories begin.
Translating traditional visual richness into a modern form.
Making fragrance the most intimate way to rediscover Indonesia.

items.name: Buton

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our team is ready to help via email.

items.question: What makes Arcanisia different from other perfume brands?
items.answer: Arcanisia is born from the soul of the Nusantara — each bottle is a cultural narrative, not just a fragrance. We blend natural ingredients unique to Indonesia's islands that are rarely found in global commercial perfumes, curated by local perfume masters dedicated to authenticity and sustainability.

items.question: How long does each Arcanisia fragrance last?
items.answer: Arcanisia fragrances typically last between 8 to 12 hours, depending on skin type and environmental conditions. Our Extrait de Parfum formula is designed for all-day longevity.

items.question: Are Arcanisia ingredients natural and safe?
items.answer: We use a blend of high-quality natural ingredients and safe synthetic materials that comply with IFRA standards, ensuring aroma consistency, skin safety, and sustainable practices.

items.question: Is Arcanisia available in travel size?
items.answer: Yes, we offer 15ml travel sizes for several of our signature collections, so you can take your favorite scent wherever you go.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard delivery is estimated at 2–5 business days for Greater Jakarta and 3–7 business days for other regions. Express options are available in selected areas.

items.question: Do you ship across Indonesia?
items.answer: Yes, we deliver nationwide through trusted logistics partners.

items.question: Can I exchange or return a product?
items.answer: Products may be exchanged or returned within 7 days of receipt, provided they are unopened, seals are intact, and an unboxing video is included.

items.question: Is Arcanisia safe for sensitive skin?
items.answer: All products are carefully formulated and tested. If you have a history of allergies, we recommend a patch test before full use.
